summary: Mamaearth’s return page is usable. It names refunds, cancels, replacements, and a grievance email. The honesty gap is the two clocks: seven days for wrong or expired product, two days for damaged or missing, with the shorter one easy to miss.

dimensions.label: Internal consistency
dimensions.note: Seven-day and two-day clocks cover different cases. Wording is clear once you read the whole page. Mild clarity hit only.

dimensions.label: Help vs marketing
dimensions.note: Cart states the FREE delivery threshold. Promo banners sit on the policy page but do not invent a liberal cancel promise.

dimensions.label: Freshness
dimensions.note: No clear last-updated stamp on the return policy. Grievance block on privacy is present.

dimensions.label: High-intent coverage
dimensions.note: Refund, cancel, return/replace, grievance email, privacy/data rights. No clear warranty article on the fetched pages.

dimensions.label: Path to a human
dimensions.note: nodal@honasa.in and return_prime form exist. /contact is a blog listing. No verified public phone on the fetched pages.

dimensions.label: Bot / chat honesty
dimensions.note: Return policy mentions a Chat option. Hours and vendor are not labelled in the fetched HTML. Neutral.

findings.title: Wrong or expired is 7 days. Damaged or missing is 2 days.
findings.whyItHurts: A customer with a crushed bottle who waits past two days is already out of policy while still inside the more visible seven-day window.
findings.fix: Put both clocks in the first paragraph and in the delivered SMS.

evidence.quote: Raise a return/ replacement request within 7 days from the date of delivery, if you’ve received wrong or expired product(s).
In case of damaged/ missing product(s), raise a return/ replacement request within 2 days from the date of delivery.

findings.title: Cancel button sounds friendly. Mamaearth can cancel without confirming you.
findings.whyItHurts: The customer path stops at Ready to Ship. The company path does not.
findings.fix: Say both rules in one sentence at the top of cancellations.

evidence.quote: You can cancel order from CANCEL button from order details page under My account section. You just need to give reason for cancellation, and leave rest on us.

Mamaearth reserves the right to cancel any order without pre-confirming the customer at any time and may verify any order before shipping the same to the customer that may include having a verbal or written confirmation from the customer.
Note - Orders can be only cancelled till the status is “Ready to Ship”.

findings.title: /contact is a blog listing, not a help desk
findings.whyItHurts: A stranger looking for a phone or ticket lands on skin-care articles.
findings.fix: Point /contact at return_prime, Chat, and the grievance email.

evidence.quote: You can also raise a request with us using the Chat option.

findings.title: FREE delivery is real, but only after the cart threshold
findings.whyItHurts: The cart states the rule. A buyer who only saw FREE in the banner still has to discover the ₹399 gap at checkout.
findings.fix: Put Free delivery over ₹399 next to the banner claim.

evidence.quote: Add ₹399 more to get FREE delivery

widgets.evidence: You can also raise a request with us using the Chat option.
